_doc: ⚑ THE PRACTICES (S144, 2026-09-15 — docs/reinterp/THE_RECORD_PLAN_2026-09-15.md §3B). One card per thing the apparatus DOES to the player across the four eras. Each card is what the Dossier's 'Your file' view shows under a ledger entry: what the system did (`did`, one line, the frame's flat voice), the dossier status — the CLAUDE.md vocabulary: documentary / contested / speculative — and `source`: a POINTER into a sourced card that already exists in data/provotypes/*.json (`{file, index}`), never a new claim. A practice with no pointer says so (`source: null`) and is `speculative` by construction. `kinds` are the ledger kinds src/witness/record.ts derives; several kinds may share one practice. Nothing here is display text in the FICTION — it is read only by the game menu, which is the frame.

profile.title: The questionnaire
profile.did: asked you to describe yourself, then filed the answers as a case

kit.title: The Starter Kit
kit.did: gave you software that had already decided what you needed

pledge.title: The pledge card
pledge.did: asked you to sign, in your own name, which way you were walking — and kept the card either way

channel.title: The channel, and the log
channel.did: routed you to people like you, and kept the transcript

referral.title: Referral by contact
referral.did: sent a friend to you by name; the friend was the network

placement.title: The placement
placement.did: arranged a residential programme with your family, then told you

provotype.title: The exercise
provotype.did: gave you a task that could only end one way, and scored the attempt

diary.title: The diary
diary.did: read what you wrote to yourself, and tried to delete it

tapes.title: The tapes
tapes.did: logged what you listened to, and for how long

belongings.title: What you were allowed to take
belongings.did: asked what you would keep, and filed the choice

checkin.title: The daily check-in
checkin.did: asked how you were, every morning, and kept the answer

assistant.title: The assistant
assistant.did: guided you, and filed whether you let it

media.title: Media as instruction
media.did: showed you a programme and recorded whether you watched it through

contact.title: Contact monitoring
contact.did: saw a message from outside before you did, and intervened

update.title: The update
update.did: changed what the machine was, and kept your file across the change

arrival.title: The migration
arrival.did: moved your file to a new service without asking you

queue.title: The correction queue
queue.did: paid you per correction to edit other people's accounts of themselves

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.did: had you answer families in the platform's voice

session.title: The restored session
session.did: finished your search for you and opened a support agent

record.title: The retained record
record.did: kept your old file 'for continuity of care'

photos.title: The Restoration tool
photos.did: restored a photograph of you to someone else

headset.title: The immersive session
headset.did: put you in a room it had built, and lost you to one it had not

termination.title: The termination
termination.did: ended the session for your safety, and named the reason

recommendation.title: The recommendation
recommendation.did: chose the next thing you would see, and filed what you were shown

testimony._doc: ⚑ S205 — 2003's testimony (s2_testimony.json); DRAFT wording for his approval.
testimony.title: The testimony
testimony.did: turned your story into the ministry's media, and filed you as its evidence

care.title: The care assignment
care.did: took your details as the gate, and assigned care on your behalf
